What changed for Druid in WoW Forever

Compared with the Classic 1.12 trees, according to the imported talent data:

Balance

  • Improved Wrath (changed): Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 10%.
  • Genesis (new): Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.
  • Moonglow (changed): Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 8%.
  • Improved Moonfire (changed): Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 5%.
  • Nature's Majesty (new): Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 2%.
  • Nature's Reach (changed): Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 10% and improves your chance to hit by 2%.
  • Improved Entangling Roots (changed): Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 25%, and its victims can take up to 25% more damage without interrupting the effect.
  • Nature's Splendor (new): Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.
  • Insect Swarm (changed): The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.
  • Vengeance (changed): Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.
  • Improved Starfire (changed): Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.1 sec and Starfire has a 3% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.
  • Overgrowth (changed): Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 1.
  • Nature's Grace (changed): All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.
  • Eclipse (new): Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.17 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.
  • Moonfury (changed): Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.
  • Moonkin Form (changed): Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their spell Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

Feral Combat

  • Ferocity (changed): Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.
  • Heart of the Wild (changed): Increases your Intellect by 2%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 4% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 2%.
  • Feral Swiftness (changed): Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 15%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 2%.
  • Feral Instinct (changed): Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 10% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 1 level higher.
  • Brutal Impact (changed): Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 0.5 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 15 sec.
  • Thick Hide (changed): While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 1 additional base Armor per level and another 0.67 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
  • Shredding Attacks (changed): Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 1.
  • Savage Fury (changed): Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 5%.
  • Feral Charge (changed): Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
  • Sharpened Claws (changed): Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 3%.
  • Shifting Power (new): Instantly convert Mana into X Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.
  • Primal Bite (new): Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.
  • Predatory Strikes (changed): Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.
  • Blood Frenzy (changed): Gives you a 50% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 50% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
  • Improved Shifting Power (new): Reduces the cooldown of your Shifting Power spell by 4 sec.
  • Leader of the Pack (changed): While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the melee and ranged Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.
  • Natural Instinct (new): Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 10% and increases your spell healing by 12% of your Intellect.
  • Natural Reaction (new): Increases your dodge chance by 1%, and gives you a 20% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.
  • Rend and Tear (new): Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 2%.
  • Berserk (new): Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form

Restoration

  • Nature's Focus (changed): Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.
  • Furor (changed): Gives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 20% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 20 Energy.
  • Naturalist (changed): Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0.1 sec and increases all damage you deal by 1%.
  • Subtlety (changed): Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 10%.
  • Reflection (changed): Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
  • Gift of Nature (changed): Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.
  • Gift of the Earthmother (new): Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.
  • Swiftmend (changed): Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.
  • Living Spirit (new): Increases your Spirit by 5%.
  • Improved Tranquility (changed): Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 50% and its cooldown by 30%.
  • Wild Growth (new): Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.
